name: Adaptive Densification
definition: An algorithm that dynamically adjusts the number, position, and scale of Gaussians during optimization to improve reconstruction quality while maintaining a fixed budget, using cloning for small high-gradient Gaussians and splitting for large high-gradient Gaussians, followed by pruning of low-gradient or oversized Gaussians.
summary: Adaptive Densification dynamically adjusts 3D Gaussians via gradient-based cloning, splitting, and pruning to improve reconstruction quality within a fixed budget.
